full_judgment:
M Reza Chowdhury J: This criminal petition for leave to appeal has arisen from the judgment and order dated 13-7-2000 passed by a Division Bench of the High Court in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 6040 of 1999 under section 561A of the of the Code of Criminal Procedure in making the Rule absolute and quashing the proceeding of Motijheel PS Non FIR Case No. 793 of 1997 under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and directing the receiver, Officer-in-Charge, Motijheel PS to hand over possession of Holding No. 59 and 59/1 Purana Pal tan, Dhaka to Humayun Kabir, second party in that proceeding. 

 2. The short facts of the case are that, the respondent No.2 the informant first party Mr Azizur Rahman, Sub-Inspector of Police, Motijheel Police Station on 12-11-1997 recorded a General Diary of Entry No. 1100 and after investigation of the matter submitted Motijheel PS Non first information report No. 793 of 1997 dated 18-11-1997 which was forwarded by Officer-in-Charge, Motijheel PS Dhaka for drawing up proceeding under section 145 CrPC against (1) Mrs Monowara Islam, (2) Abdul Alim the appointed attorney of Monowara Islam, (1) Humayun Kabir (2) Nabal Ali Hyder Khan (3) Ali Sorwar the other second party and 10 others who are tenants of Mrs Monowara Islam. The learned Magistrate drew up proceeding under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and attached the property and appointed the Officer-in-Charge as receiver. Although the proceeding was started in respect of holding No. 58/1 of Purana Paltan the receiver on the basis of the proceeding not only took over possession of holding No. 58/1 but also possession of holding No. 59 from second party Humayun Kabir and handed over possession of the same to the second party Mrs Monowara Islam. Subsequently, when this fact was brought to the notice of the Magistrate, the Magistrate by passing several orders directed the Officer-in-Charge to hand over possession of the holding No. 59 and 59/1 to second party Humayun Kabir but these orders of the Magistrate were not carried out by the Officer-in-Charge of Motijheel PS. After taking possession from the Officer-in-Charge, second party Monowara Islam through her constituted Attorney Abdul Alim moved the High Court Division under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure for quashing the above proceeding and obtained a Rule. The learned Advocate appearing for the second party Humayun Kabir pointed out that the application was filed only to thwart the order of the Magistrate for handing over possession of holding Nos. 59 and 59/1 to second party Humayun Kabir. It was submitted before the High Court Division that as the proceeding was stayed at the time of issuing the. Rule, the possession of holding Nos. 59 and 59/1 Purana Paltan was not handed over to the second party Humayun Kabir by Officer-in-Charge of Motijheel PS.
